items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember his brother's band? And Fess tells us about Buddy Johnson... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he had a band.

ctx.x: Yeah, Yank, Yank played with me. Yank, I'm going to tell you, the last job Yank played with me, it was in the baseball park with the river. It was, it was a good Friday. Good Friday and it rained all day and all night. And we was playing that park, we were going to have a game, you know? Couldn't have the game, couldn't have the game, because it rained all day and all night. But that last job Yank played with me, yeah, Yank played with me. Yeah, he played with me.
Do you remember his brother's band? And Fess tells us about Buddy Johnson, like he had sort of a society band.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: So, I came down and sort of, I found that he was a teacher. So, well, I got me a book. And I went and took lessons from him.

ctx.x: With, uh, some band or nothing. I forgot the name of the band now. But he came there with that band and played. So, and I know him. So, I came down and sort of, I found that he was a teacher. So, well, I got me a book. And I went and took lessons from him. See? So, I took lessons there. I must have took lessons for two, three years, or something like that. And, uh... What kind of books, now?

items.q: When I came here, I went to Manu Mineta.

When I came here, I went to Manu Mineta.
